title: PartFacts
description: Kernel-measured facts about a solid produced from a printspec part. PartFacts are the comparable, provenance-carrying output of a geometry kernel (OCP/OCCT, brepjs, ...). They are compared for equality by rounding within a tolerance, never by hashing geometry bytes, because OCCT is not bit-reproducible.

printspecVersion.description: printspec schema version the source spec was written against.

generator.description: Identifier of the kernel/generator that produced these facts (e.g. 'ocp', 'brepjs').

generatorVersion.description: Version of the generator/worker code that produced these facts.

kernelVersion.description: Exact geometry kernel version string (e.g. the observed OCCT/OCP version). Part of the correctness contract.

imageDigest.description: Content-addressable digest of the container image the kernel ran in (e.g. 'sha256:...'). Pins the kernel build that produced these facts.

specHash.description: Hash of the normalized source spec these facts were measured from. Advisory provenance; not a geometry hash.

tolerance.description: How the numeric facts were rounded for comparison.

decimals.description: Number of decimal places every measured float was rounded to before being recorded.

measurements.description: The measured geometric facts of the solid.

centerOfMass.description: Centre of mass [x, y, z] in mm.

topology.description: Unique sub-shape counts (counted with a shape map, not an explorer, so shared sub-shapes are not double-counted).

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings emitted while building/measuring the solid.
